Class RewardsController

java.lang.Object
com.rewards.rewards_api.controller.RewardsController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/rewards") public class RewardsController extends Object
REST controller that exposes endpoints for retrieving customer rewards.

This controller is part of the web layer in a layered architecture (Controller -> Service -> Repository). Its primary responsibility is to handle HTTP requests related to rewards and delegate business logic to the RewardsService. The controller performs no business calculations itself and only converts incoming HTTP requests into service calls and returns the resulting DTOs.

Typical responsibilities:

  • Expose REST endpoints for rewards-related operations.
  • Delegate to the service layer for business processing.
  • Return DTOs suitable for serialization to JSON.

This class is designed to be thin: all business rules and validations belong to the service and repository layers. The controller is intentionally free of complex logic so it can be exercised easily by integration tests and framework-level concerns (e.g. request mapping, filters).

  • Method Details

    • getAllRewards

      @GetMapping public List<RewardResponse> getAllRewards()
      GET endpoint to return rewards aggregated per customer.

      This endpoint delegates to RewardsService.getAllRewards() and returns the list of RewardResponse DTOs. The service performs all aggregation of transactions into 0-30, 31-60 and 61-90 day buckets and computes total points per customer. The controller simply returns the DTOs produced by the service for HTTP serialization.

      Returns:
      a list of RewardResponse representing per-customer reward summaries. The returned list will contain one entry per customer with their aggregated points.
      Throws:
      TransactionNotFoundException - if no transactions exist in the underlying repository; this is propagated from the service layer and results in a 404 when handled by the application's global exception handler.
      Since:
      0.0.1
